blocks.name: Original 257-page stack and access scope
blocks.description: All pages, reference formulas, annotations and project content are original OpenCVDataflowGUI contributor work, MIT. No customer or third-party media. 257 top-left TIFF pages alternate uint16 gray, uint8 BGR, float32 gray and float64 gray; negative/HDR values are deliberate. Select a zero-based Page index or wire the integer input. The wired counter uses Start as a selector and Step=0; change its Start to request another page without changing the TIFF block. Repeat Run once to observe cache hits and fresh tickets. Only requested pages are decoded; intermediate TIFF directories still need traversal. Two-page/512 KiB LRU bounds raw retained pages. On-change checks file identity/times; Verify content hashes each request; Pinned ignores changes until reset/path change. Page-outside-stack and workspace-limit cases deliberately emit no image. Content/page pixel grids do not establish camera or physical calibration.
